title: SRI and AT&T chairman meeting on unacknowledged projects

tellings.quote: I I was once at a meeting with uh a chairman of SRRI and AT&T.

plain: In the 1990s, a guest named Steven Greer says, he sat in a meeting with a chairman connected to SRI, a California research institute, and to the phone company AT&T, about unacknowledged projects, meaning secret programmes whose existence the government does not admit. Greer tells Michels first-hand, "I was once at a meeting with a chairman of SRI and AT&T." He offers it as proof that big corporations, not just the government, hold UFO secrets.
